Strong programming skills in C, C++, Java, or Python and expertise working with the statistical software R.

Master's degree in statistics, bioinformatics, computational biology, or related field.
Familiarity with big data processing pipelines.
Training in statistics or machine learning.

Demonstrates a commitment to growth, attention to detail and a pursuit of excellence.
Expertise in standard bioinformatics tools.

cond_0594.intro: We are looking for a Bioinformatics Research Analyst to join our team. The lab focuses on the genetics of neurodevelopmental disorders, including autism and 9p minus syndrome. Computational work includes analysis of genomics datasets from novel genomic technologies, software design, and improving computational workflows. You will work alongside investigators and institutions to support this research.
cond_0594.responsibilities:
Collaborate with the team to implement algorithms and computer software for analyzing omics-based datasets (high-throughput, massively parallel genomic/proteomic/clinical)
Work with others to develop data management and analysis solutions that support the storage, investigation, and sharing of large datasets
Coordinate research projects with other investigators and institutions
Participate alongside colleagues in developing hypotheses and experimental design
Assist with reporting of methods, data, and results
cond_0594.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, bioinformatics, biostatistics, or related field plus two years of experience; or master's degree in computer science, bioinformatics, biostatistics, or related field; or combined education and experience of seven years.
Master's degree in statistics, bioinformatics, computational biology, or related field.
Experience working in unix/linux environments, including basic shell scripting.
Familiarity with big data processing pipelines.
Strong programming skills in C, C++, Java, or Python and expertise working with the statistical software R.
Training in statistics or machine learning a plus.
Experience working with next-generation sequencing data and an interest in developing novel bioinformatic workflows and statistical methods to be applied in a biological setting.
Collaboration with research groups.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Demonstrates a commitment to growth, attention to detail and a pursuit of excellence.
Good understanding of computational biology.
Ability to analyze and interpret large complex data sets, such as genome sequencing, microarray gene expression studies, human genetic studies, and model organism studies, and to communicate data in a clear, concise manner.
Expertise in standard bioinformatics tools.

Collaboration with research groups.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Good understanding of computational biology.
